name: smog-ai
description: Real-time AI desktop assistant — interview copilot, screen analysis, automated notes.
author: smog

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node scripts/check-worklet.cjs && node scripts/e2e.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --publish never && node scripts/build-manifest.cjs
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never && node scripts/build-manifest.cjs
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never && node scripts/build-manifest.cjs
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never && node scripts/build-manifest.cjs
